gbm_population_evidence.quote: Ependymoma; Medulloblastoma; Glioblastoma; Primary Brain Tumor

Patients must have prior documented progressive or refractory disease with histologically proven initial diagnosis of ependymoma, medulloblastoma, glioblastoma, or another type of primary cancer of the central nervous system with no curative conventional therapy options available.

candidate_evidence.quote: The GCC2020 trial is a prospective open-label phase 1 trial to determine the best safe dose of the BTK-inhibitor ibrutinib to use in combination with previously studied chemo-immunotherapy regimens comprised of the investigational IDO-inhibitor indoximod plus oral palliative chemotherapy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have prior documented progressive or refractory disease

role_evidence.quote: Repurposing Ibrutinib for Chemo-Immunotherapy in a Phase 1b Study of Ibrutinib With Indoximod Plus Metronomic Cyclophosphamide and Etoposide for Pediatric Patients With Brain Cancer
To determine the pediatric recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D) of ibrutinib, when combined with indoximod-based chemo-immunotherapy (Regimen A)

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: IDO (indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase) and BTK (Bruton's tyrosine Kinase) form a closely linked metabolic checkpoint in tumor-associated antigen-presenting cells

role_evidence.quote: to determine the best safe dose of the BTK-inhibitor ibrutinib to use in combination with previously studied chemo-immunotherapy regimens comprised of the investigational IDO-inhibitor indoximod plus oral palliative chemotherapy

The central clinical hypothesis for the GCC2020 study is that combining ibrutinib (BTK-inhibitor) with indoximod (IDO-inhibitor) during chemotherapy will synergistically enhance anti-tumor immune responses

flag.reason: Indoximod is investigational and part of the stated synergy hypothesis, but is given in every arm as part of a previously studied backbone regimen; could be experimental_combination.

role_evidence.quote: Ibrutinib will be combined with either indoximod plus oral cyclophosphamide and etoposide (Regimen A) or indoximod plus oral temozolomide (Regimen B).
